metadataSemantics: derived replay recipe; canonical reachability is not executed inference
slot: rgbh1-<64-character configuration digest hex>-<4-character revision hex>
revision: 0 configuration; one per frame; one optional final native-source completion
newPrefix: only held ledgered native results with exact class/model/zone and predecessor chains
recovery: exact session + current canonical anchor; no gaps; pending root distinct from committed prefix
conflict: immutable revision slot; no overwrite or competing branch
externalReferences: HTTP original and native-completion roots live in the original publisher; verified by native replay
localChildren: configuration object and every referenced RGB evidence archive root
authority: explicit separate HistoryAuthority and RgbArchiveAuthority, rechecked before I/O and at publication cuts
cost: bounded quadratic cumulative prefix/custody work; no throughput or hard-real-time qualification
